name: perform forward-pass inference with learned weights
definition: Execute the arithmetic of the network using the loaded weights to compute per-class scores for an input image.
failure_mode: Wrong architecture math yields off-by errors in labels.

name: persist a fitted model to a pickle file
definition: Serialize the trained model to a pickle file at a fixed path.

name: preserve the installed pinned library versions
definition: keep the preinstalled transformers and torch packages intact rather than removing or replacing them.
failure_mode: altering the toolchain changes the api signatures and breaks the offline load path

name: produce a trained-model snapshot file
definition: Ensure the framework writes a real weights snapshot at the iterations/layer node matching the configured count.
